{"consolidated_memory":"DEPLOYMENT CRASH LOOP: Multiple incidents in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (2026-02-02 to 2026-07-31)

COMMON PATTERN ACROSS ALL INCIDENTS:
- Component: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure side)
- Symptom: Container restarting a few seconds after start (crash loop)
- Reproduction: Roll out to the small node pool
- Stack: YAML
- Covering check: Manifest lint and dry run in CI

SEVEN SEPARATE OCCASIONS WITH DISTINCT ROOT CAUSES AND FIXES:

[1] 2026-02-02 - v1 SDK clients trigger serialiser bug
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only for clients pinned to v1 SDK
   Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
   Fix: PR #1228 (branch fix/crash-loop-1) - switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
   Result: Throughput rose 58 percent, to 56 requests per second

[2] 2026-02-04 - Lazy initialisation race condition
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only after client had already retried once
   Root cause: Race in lazy initialisation
   Fix: PR #1431 (branch fix/crash-loop-2) - guarded init with double-checked lock
   Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 50 days running

[3] 2026-04-08 - Slice bound off-by-one error
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only when input list came in empty
   Root cause: Off-by-one in slice bound
   Fix: PR #1907 (branch fix/crash-loop-4) - corrected the bound and added property test
   Result: Reclaimed 16 GB of blob storage

[4] 2026-05-30 - Missing Unicode normalisation
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only after rolling restart of fleet
   Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
   Fix: PR #7230 (branch fix/crash-loop-5) - normalised to NFC ahead of digest
   Result: p99 latency fell from 1.9 s to 963 ms

[5] 2026-06-15 - Missing composite database index
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
   Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
   Fix: PR #7880 (branch fix/crash-loop-6) - added composite index and backfilled in batches
   Result: Job finished in 45 minutes instead of 7 hours

[6] 2026-07-25 - N+1 query behind lazy relation
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only when two requests raced on the same key
   Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
   Fix: PR #8002 (branch fix/crash-loop-7) - prefetched relation in single query
   Result: Error rate dropped from 6.5 percent to under 8 per ten thousand

[7] 2026-07-31 - Connection pool exhaustion on cold start
   Trigger: Crash loop appeared only on first request after cold start
   Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
   Fix: PR #9113 (branch fix/crash-loop-8) - raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue in front
   Result: Cold start dropped 38 percent, to 934 ms"}
